title: Deeper/broader entity-specific DXF coordinate frames and arbitrary-axis boundary review
scope: ezdxf, FreeCAD, and ACadSharp source-level transform cross-checks

method.kind: Read-only review of authoritative DXF references, public peer source/docs, and current local source/tests
method.limitations: FreeCAD, ezdxf, and ACadSharp sources are mutable or operation-specific and were not bound to exact runtime artifacts. Their source behavior is a cross-check only, not conformance or native acceptance evidence. The local generated tests were source-inspected, not run in this pass.

sources.observed: The OCS summary distinguishes planar entities whose points are OCS, 3D entities whose points are WCS, mixed-frame DIMENSION data, and WCS VIEWPORT data.
The arbitrary-axis rule uses Wy cross N only if both absolute X and Y normal components are strictly below 1/64; equality selects Wz cross N.
ELLIPSE center and major-axis endpoint-relative-to-center are explicitly WCS values; group 210 is an optional extrusion direction.
INSERT insertion point is OCS; scale factors default to 1 independently; rotation, row/column counts and spacings, and extrusion are distinct fields.
LWPOLYLINE vertices are OCS, group 38 is elevation, and group 210 is extrusion direction.

sources.revision: stable docs reviewed 2026-10-17; exact installed version not bound
sources.observed: The tutorial separates OCS elevation and thickness, notes LWPOLYLINE/HATCH elevation representation, and describes ELLIPSE extrusion as a direction where center/axis coordinates remain WCS rather than OCS.
The legacy Draft importer source contains an explicit 1/64 arbitrary-axis branch and constructs OCS placement for its importer route; no exact FreeCAD release was run or qualified.
Entity transforms route through OCS/world matrices using Matrix3.ArbitraryAxis; the source was not pinned to a released artifact or executed.

calculateAxis implements the strict 1/64 predicate and extrusionUnitVector normalizes a temporary direction while retaining the entity field. processEllipse does not apply the OCS helper. Existing generated ARC/LWPOLYLINE vectors use Ny=0 for the below/above cutoff cases, so they leave the Y predicate and equality untested.

assessment.coordinateFrameRule: Treat coordinate meaning as entity-specific, not group-code-specific. Keep raw OCS/WCS fields, legacy applyExt projection, and consumer world geometry as separate observations.
assessment.ellipseRule: Preserve ELLIPSE center and major-axis fields as WCS and do not apply the planar OCS helper a second time; group 210 supplies the plane normal.
assessment.localGap: The existing generated accepted-normal vectors cover X below and above 1/64 but keep Y zero, leaving the second predicate and strict equality boundary without direct generated coverage. This is a test-readiness gap, not a demonstrated production defect.
assessment.comparatorRule: Mutable peer source and app import routes may inform candidate transform profiles but cannot count as runtime conformance, independent semantic truth, or native acceptance without exact pinning and execution.
